title: Perfect active: read the claim
subtitle: Translate the perfect from context, not a formula.
overview: The perfect normally brings a prior action and resulting state into view; English wording varies.
Some high-frequency perfects have present meaning in English; read the lexical item and sentence rather than forcing “has …ed.”

sections.title: Forms
rows: I know — perfect in form, present in meaning

items.en: We know that he is true.
